an10.94:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Campāyaṃ viharati Gaggarāya pokkharaṇiyā tīre.
an10.94:1.2: Atha kho Vajjiyamāhito gahapati divādivassa Campāya nikkhami Bhagavantaṃ dassanāya.
an10.94:1.3: Atha kho Vajjiyamāhitassa gahapatissa etad ahosi
an10.94:1.8: yan nūnāhaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo ten' upasaṅkameyyan' ti.
an10.94:2.1: Atha kho Vajjiyamāhito gahapati yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo ten' upasaṅkami. 2.
an10.94:2.2: Tena kho pana samayena aññatitthiyā paribbājakā saṅgamma samāgamma unnādino uccāsaddā mahāsaddā anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ kathentā nisinnā honti.
an10.94:3.1: Addasaṃsu kho te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā Vajjiyamāhitaṃ gahapatiṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ, disvāna aññamaññaṃ saṇṭhāpesuṃ:
an10.94:3.2: ‘Appasaddā bhonto hontu, mā bhonto saddam akattha.
an10.94:3.3: Ayaṃ Vajjiyamāhito gahapati āgacchati samaṇassa Gotamassa sāvako.
an10.94:3.4: Yāvatā kho pana samaṇassa Gotamassa sāvakā gihī odātavasanā Campāyaṃ paṭivasanti, ayaṃ tesaṃ aññataro Vajjiyamāhito gahapati.
an10.94:3.5: Appasaddakāmā kho pana te āyasmanto appasaddavinītā appasaddassa vaṇṇavādino.
an10.94:3.6: App eva nāma appasaddaṃ parisaṃ viditvā upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññeyyā' ti.
an10.94:4.1: Atha kho te paribbājakā tuṇhī ahesuṃ. 3.
an10.94:4.2: Atha kho Vajjiyamāhito gahapati yena paribbājakā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodi,
an10.94:4.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Vajjiyamāhitaṃ gahapatiṃ te paribbājakā etad avocuṃ
an10.94:4.4: ‘saccaṃ kira gahapati, samaṇo Gotamo sabbaṃ tapaṃ garahati, sabbaṃ tapassiṃ lūkhājīviṃ ekaṃsena upakkosati upavadatī' ti?
an10.94:4.5: ‘Na kho bhante Bhagavā sabbaṃ tapaṃ garahati, na pi sabbaṃ tapassiṃ lūkhājīviṃ ekaṃsena upakkosati upavadati.
an10.94:4.6: Gārayhaṃ kho bhante Bhagavā garahati, pasaṃsiyaṃ pasaṃsati,
an10.94:4.7: gārayhaṃ kho pana bhante Bhagavā garahanto pasaṃsiyaṃ pasaṃsanto vibhajjavādo Bhagavā,
an10.94:4.8: na so Bhagavā ettha ekaṃsavādo' ti. 4.
an10.94:5.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro paribbājako Vajjiyamāhitaṃ gahapatiṃ etad avoca
an10.94:5.2: ‘āgamehi tvaṃ gahapati, yassa tvaṃ samaṇassa Gotamassa vaṇṇaṃ bhāsasi, so samaṇo Gotamo venayiko appaññattiko' ti?
an10.94:5.3: ‘Ettha p' āhaṃ bhante āyasmante vakkhāmi saha dhammena:
an10.94:5.4: idaṃ kusalan ti bhante Bhagavatā paññattaṃ,
an10.94:5.5: idaṃ akusalan ti bhante Bhagavatā paññattaṃ.
an10.94:5.6: Iti kusalākusalaṃ Bhagavā paññāpayamāno sappaññattiko Bhagavā,
an10.94:5.7: na so Bhagavā venayiko appaññattiko' ti.
an10.94:6.1: Evaṃ vutte te paribbājakā tuṇhībhūtā maṅkubhūtā pattakkhandhā adhomukhā pajjhāyantā appaṭibhānā nisīdiṃsu. 5.
an10.94:6.2: Atha kho Vajjiyamāhito gahapati te paribbājake tuṇhībhūte maṅkubhūte pattakkhandhe adhomukhe pajjhāyante appaṭibhāne viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an10.94:6.3: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Vajjiyamāhito gahapati yāvatako ahosi tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo, taṃ sabbaṃ Bhagavato ārocesi. 6.
an10.94:7.2: evaṃ kho te gahapati moghapurisā kālena kālaṃ saha dhammena suniggahītaṃ niggahetabbā.
an10.94:7.3: Nāhaṃ gahapati sabbaṃ tapaṃ tapitabban ti vadāmi.
an10.94:7.4: Na panāhaṃ gahapati sabbaṃ tapaṃ na tapitabban ti vadāmi.
an10.94:7.5: Nāhaṃ gahapati sabbaṃ samādānaṃ samāditabban ti vadāmi.
an10.94:7.6: Na panāhaṃ gahapati sabbaṃ samādānaṃ na samāditabban ti vadāmi.
an10.94:7.7: Nāhaṃ gahapati sabbaṃ padhānaṃ padahitabban ti vadāmi.
an10.94:7.8: Na panāhaṃ gahapati sabbaṃ padhānaṃ na padahitabban ti vadāmi.
an10.94:7.9: Nāhaṃ gahapati sabbo paṭinissaggo paṭinissajjitabbo ti vadāmi.
an10.94:7.10: Na panāhaṃ gahapati sabbo paṭinissaggo na paṭinissajjitabbo ti vadāmi.
an10.94:7.11: Nāhaṃ gahapati sabbā vimutti vimuccitabbā ti vadāmi.
an10.94:7.12: Na panāhaṃ gahapati sabbā vimutti na vimuccitabbā ti vadāmi. 7.
an10.94:8.1: Yaṃ hi gahapati tapaṃ tapato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti, evarūpaṃ tapaṃ na tapitabban ti vadāmi.
an10.94:8.2: Yañ ca khvāssa gahapati tapaṃ tapato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, evarūpaṃ tapaṃ tapitabban ti vadāmi.
an10.94:9.1: Yaṃ hi gahapati samādānaṃ samādiyato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti, evarūpaṃ samādānaṃ na samāditabban ti vadāmi.
an10.94:9.2: Yañ ca khvāssa gahapati samādānaṃ samādiyato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, evarūpaṃ samādānaṃ samāditabban ti vadāmi.
an10.94:10.1: Yaṃ hi gahapati padhānaṃ padahato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti, evarūpaṃ padhānaṃ na padahitabban ti vadāmi.
an10.94:10.2: Yañ ca khvāssa gahapati padhānaṃ padahato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, evarūpaṃ padhānaṃ padahitabban ti vadāmi.
an10.94:11.1: Yaṃ hi gahapati paṭinissaggaṃ paṭinissajjato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti, evarūpo paṭinissaggo na paṭinissajjitabbo ti vadāmi.
an10.94:11.2: Yañ ca khvāssa gahapati paṭinissaggaṃ paṭinissajjato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, evarūpo paṭinissaggo paṭinissajjitabbo ti vadāmi.
an10.94:12.1: Yaṃ hi gahapati vimuttiṃ vimuccato akusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, kusalā dhammā parihāyanti, evarūpā vimutti na vimuccitabbā ti vadāmi.
an10.94:12.2: Yañ ca khvāssa gahapati vimuttiṃ vimuccato akusalā dhammā parihāyanti, kusalā dhammā abhivaḍḍhanti, evarūpā vimutti vimuccitabbā ti vadāmī ti.
an10.94:13.1: Atha kho Vajjiyamāhito gahapati Bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi. 8.
an10.94:14.1: Atha kho Bhagavā acirapakkante Vajjiyamāhite gahapatimhi bhikkhū āmantesi:--
an10.94:14.2: Yo pi so bhikkhu dīgharattaṃ apparajakkho imasmiṃ dhammavinaye, so pi evam evaṃ aññatitthiye paribbājake saha dhammena suniggahītaṃ niggaṇheyya, yathā taṃ Vajjiyamāhitena gahapatinā niggahītā
